tool_input.command: cd modules/caddyhttp/reverseproxy && cat streams.go && git diff streaming.go | head -400

findings.text: Streams to dynamic upstreams (keyed by di.String(), never in the live set) are never closed by a reload in detached mode; documented in the field comment but not tested.
removeLive deletes r.open[u] only for orphaned upstreams, and remove() leaves empty inner maps behind for live upstreams, a small leak that is harmless in practice.

coverage.note: Real server: the stream survives a reload that keeps its upstream and is closed after a reload that removes it.
Caddyfile and JSON parsing plus defaults are asserted (TestStreamOptionsJSON).
Immediate close (TestStreamIsClosedOnReload) and delayed close are both checked on a real server.
The handshake is absent from the access log with skip_handshake and present by default (TestDetachedStreamCloseLogAfterReload).
The close entry has logger http.log.access.access and level debug, and is written after the reload. The warn level is checked in TestStreamLogsSkipHandshake.
The recorder, encode and intercept each have their own hijack and 101 tests that assert no further writes reach the underlying writer.
Echo through intercept with handle_response and through encode, with access logging, and an ordinary response is still intercepted.
A real h2 extended CONNECT is echoed. The HTTP/1.1 upgrade with stream_detached is covered by TestDetachedStreamFollowsItsUpstream.
The metrics test and TestUpgradedStreamIsAccountedOnce in streaming_test.go check that the gauge returns to its starting value and each counter moves once.
Integration tests cover the reload modes, h2 extended CONNECT, encode, intercept and detached access logging.
Unit tests exist for the recorder, encode, intercept, registry and cleanup, metrics and Caddyfile parsing.
